title: BotCommandRefusedPayload
description: bot.command.refused v1 (OpenVibe.Bot server/domain/index.js auditCommand). The gate refused a command (role, allowlist, limits, policy, e-stop, cooldown, turn, device offline) or a device reported an e-stop for a robot it is not attached to (kind estop_state). reason is Bot's refusal code; ids, kinds and codes only, never the value. Envelope: subject { type: robot, id: <robot id> }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:bot.
